answer: Enter your teacher's joining code from your profile to join a course.
You can view and edit your profile here.
See what's new across your courses here.
Your marks for every lesson you've been graded on are here.
Open a course to watch its lesson recordings.
A quiz appears on its lesson once your teacher opens it — not before.
A handout appears alongside its lesson's recording when your teacher has added one.
Answers are released by your teacher after the quiz opens.
Every approved teacher is listed in the directory, with what they've published so far.
There's no password reset in this app yet — ask your administrator for help.
